policies.text: An item is selected for priority store display once green catalog classification is granted.
A model receives green catalog classification provided consumer endorsement is awarded and its energy consumption rating does not exceed 15 watts.
A product secures distribution readiness if regulatory clearance is confirmed.
Hardware gains regulatory clearance when it possesses an FCC compliance certificate.
A health device receives European trade approval provided it retains a CE mark accreditation.
Merchandise attains consumer endorsement if distribution readiness is active and its product return rate remains under 5 percent.
An enterprise fleet gains extra insurance coverage when its service duration spans at least 3 years.
An energy storage unit achieves heavy-duty status if its total capacity reaches at least 40 kWh.
A regional distributor obtains preferred partner standing if its operating history exceeds 10 years.
